maria (CSM): Heads-up — 30d exec-readiness countdown for AtlasCorp. Primary asks: slides, renewal risk triage, enablement dry-run. Can folks own items?
aj (AE): I'll take the renewal risk section and run stakeholder map.
sasha (SE): I'll do a tech slide + demo fallback notes. Need capacity numbers from infra.
maria (CSM): thx. Risk tags: High / Medium / Low. Aj, what's current NPS signal?
aj (AE): NPS 46 last month, but onboarding lag on SSO caused complaints. I'll add risk=Medium. :thinking_face: 
devin (Product PM): Product will add note about planned optimizer patch (ships in 2w) to reduce latency — helps renewal.
ops-bot: calendar: exec-readiness dry-run scheduled for 2024-12-08 16:00 UTC — invite sent to @maria @aj @sasha @devin
maria (CSM): can we run a 20m enablement dry-run prior to exec? propose 12/05 17:00 UTC. Sasha and Devin, pls confirm.
sasha (SE): confirm 12/05 works. I'll prepare demo fallback script and a short perf slide.
devin (Product PM): confirm. I'll prep the patch note + rollback plan snippet.
maria (CSM): action owners:
```
- Slides: maria
- Renewal risk + stakeholder map: aj
- Tech demo + fallbacks: sasha
- Product patch note: devin
- Slide review: maria + aj
```
aj (AE): I'll owner the stakeholder readout and capture exec asks in the ADO ticket.
sasha (SE): FYI, will include a one-slide latency breakdown and a 'what-if' fallback flow.
maria (CSM): capturing feedback loop — after exec we'll send a 1-question survey to execs, and log responses in the "Atlasfeedback" doc.
aj (AE): suggest pre-emptively include 'cost delta vs current infra' slide — execs care.
maria (CSM): good call. Sasha, can you add a cost note? even rough delta.
sasha (SE): yep I'll add a quick table.
maria (CSM): last: renewal signal threshold is 2 negative exec comments or 'high' risk tag -> escalate to AE+CS leader. Aj acknowledge?
aj (AE): ack. I'll ping finance if escalation triggers.
maria (CSM): thanks team — I'll update the action tracker and share slide links by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
